redeploy.title: Move to another server
redeploy.body: Restore this server's data, .env file and folders onto another server.
redeploy.needsCode: The other server must already have the project's code and its virtual environment.
redeploy.backupHint: The newest django-dbs backup is chosen.
redeploy.archivesHint: Optional. Each archive is unpacked in its own folder on the other server.
redeploy.flush: Replace the data on the other server instead of merging
redeploy.passwordHint: Needed to move for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Moving
progress.rehearsed: The rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed on the other server.

errors.targetRequired: Choose the server to move to.

errors.passphrase_missing: The backup passphrase of this server is not saved here.
errors.confirm_name_mismatch: Type the other server's name exactly as shown.
errors.same_server: Choose a server other than this one.
errors.target_not_ready: django-dbs is not installed on the other server, or the project is not ready there.
